summary: Fixed the two coverage defects and the CLI gap the T28 review reproduced with an executable probe, regression first, by editing only src/security/path-scan.ts, src/commands/security.ts and src/commands/security-recursive-scan.test.ts. (1) F-004: the duplicate-by-canonical-identity skip row and the scanned row (path-scan.ts:168/227-229) now key on displayPath (the entry actually encountered) instead of the canonical target, while the visited Set keyed on device:inode identity still stops cycles and duplicate scanning unchanged. (2) F-003: a non-recursive directory scan (path-scan.ts:194-197) now calls incomplete('recursive traversal disabled') alongside its skip row, which service.ts's untouched pass->incomplete fold turns into a truthful incomplete/non-pass outcome instead of a clean pass over zero scanned files. (3) F-005: security.ts gained --no-recursive (recursiveScanFlag) forwarded into runScanPath, so the CLI flag and the exported API now agree; scanPathArgument and the usage/help text were updated to match. Three new regression tests (one per repair) were added to security-recursive-scan.test.ts; all 6 tests in that file pass (46 expect() calls), the combined guard/persistence-sinks/recursive-scan selection is 40 passed / 0 failed (130 expect() calls), typecheck and eslint are clean on every changed file, and T28-scan-probe.ts was run before and after: the diff is confined to the files[] rows F-004 fixes, every other section (EISDIR, leak-safety, limits, fail+incomplete fold, --recursive/default parity, single-file target) is byte-identical. src/security/service.ts was read for context only and not modified.

acceptance.criterion: Policy (policies.md, security scan): the report contains per-file scanned/skipped/failed outcomes with reasons that match what actually happened to each encountered entry, no contradictory duplicate rows, and no closed name exposed to an unauthorized caller; findings are preserved independently of coverage.

changed_files.change: F-004: the duplicate-identity skip row and the scanned row (+ the parallel contents.push) now key on displayPath (the encountered entry) instead of the canonical target; the canonical-identity visited Set is unchanged. F-003: a non-recursive directory's skip row now also calls incomplete('recursive traversal disabled'), so coverage never stays 'complete' over an unopened directory.

F-005: added recursiveScanFlag(args) parsing --recursive/--no-recursive and forwarding an explicit choice into runScanPath; scanPathArgument now also skips --no-recursive; usage strings and the help option table updated to document --no-recursive.

Added three regression tests, one per repair: encountered-path row keying and no-contradictory-duplicates (F-004), non-recursive directory never reads as a clean pass (F-003), and --recursive/--no-recursive CLI parity with actual scan behavior (F-005).
